quest.title: The Commission's Commission
quest.description: The Yashiro Commission's Madarame Hyakubei seems to have something to say to you...

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Honored guest, a moment, if you please. I trust you are the Traveler of whom Miss Kamisato has previously spoken?

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Then please forgive my intrusion. I am Madarame Hyakubei, a retainer of the Kamisato Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: I have heard tell of your great deeds, and Miss Kamisato thinks extremely highly of you. No doubt you are one of great honor, and worthy of our trust.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: I have long since wished for the pleasure of making your acquaintance. Unfortunately, I have been unable to extricate myself from my duties recently.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: On the contrary, it is you who are too modest. Even the Yashiro Commissioner Kamisato Ayato himself has mentioned you before. He, too, believes that you are worthy of our trust.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: I'll get to the point. Since the Yashiro Commission oversees worship at the shrine, we often have the occasion to hear about people's earnest ambitions.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: Miss Kamisato, being as kind and thoughtful as she is, convinced the Yashiro Commissioner to allocate resources to help people realize their ambitions.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: After some deliberation, he decided to establish a public commission system as the means of achieving this. I am the one he assigned to organize it.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: The remuneration is more than ample, but the problem is that there are too many commissions and not enough people to handle them... If you were willing to lend your assistance, that would be wonderful.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: If you are unable to start right away, that's no problem. You can simply find me in a few days' time when your schedule is freer.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: I have compiled the details of the commissions that we've received so far, if you wish to take a closer look.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: Haha, you are every bit as forthright as the stories claim. Please excuse my habitual meandering.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: If you should ever have the time and the desire, we would be most grateful indeed for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: If all goes well, you will not only be well compensated but your reputation in Inazuma will be enhanced.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Of course, even one such as yourself cannot become a local legend overnight. As with many things in life, you will need to start from something small and work your way up.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Specifically, this means that as your reputation builds up, the commissions you have access to will grow in complexity. Consider it a gauge of the level of trust that people here place in you.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Please give it some thought. It goes without saying that I'd be thrilled if you were willing to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: I will leave you to think it over.
